def fill_line_gaps(grid, color, continue_line=False):
    """Fill background cells sandwiched between two marks in their row/column.
    continue_line=True: only fill when the gap continues a collinear line
    (at least one endpoint extends away from the gap with the same color)."""
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    def try_fill(i, j, di, dj):
        a = out[i-di][j-dj]; c = out[i+di][j+dj]
        if a == bg or c == bg or a != c:
            return False
        if not continue_line:
            return a != color and c != color
        # line continuation: an endpoint extends beyond with the same color
        ai, aj = i-2*di, j-2*dj
        ci, cj = i+2*di, j+2*dj
        ext_a = 0 <= ai < h and 0 <= aj < w and out[ai][aj] == a
        ext_c = 0 <= ci < h and 0 <= cj < w and out[ci][cj] == c
        return ext_a or ext_c
    changed = True
    first = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(1, w-1):
                if out[i][j] == bg and try_fill(i, j, 0, 1):
                    out[i][j] = color; changed = True
        for j in range(w):
            for i in range(1, h-1):
                if out[i][j] == bg and try_fill(i, j, 1, 0):
                    out[i][j] = color; changed = True
        if not continue_line:

    return out
